en.html:
Following that practice, I brought the enemy back into view.
Naturally. This fellow had left Captain Ootori’s life hanging between yes and no. Now I should show him my back?

Until that disgusting shape was knocked out of the sky, my sword was not returning to its sheath.
The anger still smoldered. With it, I advanced.

ja.html:
作法に則り、敵影を<ruby>視界<rt>モニター</rt></ruby>へ戻す。
　当然だ……大鳥大尉の生死を定かならぬものとして
くれた相手に、どうして背中を向けられるか！

　あの不快極まる姿を叩き落とすまで、太刀は納めら
れない。
　俺は燻り続ける怒りと共に、進撃した。
